source.post_text:
some people build startups

@a1lon9 built a website called pumpfun where people launch memecoins

somehow it generated $83M in fees in the last 30 days

silicon valley might be overthinking this whole startup thing 😭

replies.text: 👆 Sometimes the tool makes the difference.
replies.author: @PocketIQ

replies.text: crazy how just enabling memecoin launches prints that kind of cash while traditional startups grind on decks and mvps. maybe the real edge is riding pure hype cycles instead of inventing problems, though the volatility cuts both ways.
replies.author: decoy

replies.text: Silicon Valley writes pitch decks. Crypto ships and finds out.
replies.author: @THChumor

replies.text: the honest answer is that building something that makes money isn't just about solving a real problem, but also about finding a way to extract value from people's desires. pumpfun tapped into the memecoin hype, and now it's making more than most startups in their first year
replies.author: @adelbucetta

decoy_rationale: The hedging clause about volatility plus the slightly explanatory framing make it feel oddly balanced and polished rather than raw.
